function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve Device Connector Versions information from a specified URL. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
To get detailed information for a specific interface on a network device, you can use one of the following methods depending on your access and the device type:

| Method | Typical command / API | What it returns |
|--------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| **CLI (SSH/Telnet)** | `show interface <name>` (e.g., `show interface GigabitEthernet0/1`) | Full interface description, status, MTU, duplex, speed, errors, counters, and configuration details. |
| **CLI (brief view)** | `show ip interface brief` | Summary of all interfaces with IP address, status, and protocol state. |
| **SNMP** | OID `1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.1` (ifIndex) + walk for `ifDescr`, `ifOperStatus`, `ifInOctets`, etc. | Interface list, operational status, traffic counters, and other metrics. |
| **RESTCONF/NETCONF** | `GET /restconf/data/interfaces/interface=<name>` | JSON/YANG representation of the interface configuration and operational state. |
| **Device API (e.g., Cisco DNA Center)** | `GET /api/v1/network-device/<id>/interfaces/<name>` | Detailed interface data including health, performance, and configuration. |

**Example CLI usage**

```bash
# Show all details for GigabitEthernet0/1
show interface GigabitEthernet0/1

# Show brief status for all interfaces
show ip interface brief
```

**Example SNMP walk**

```bash
snmpwalk -v2c -c public 192.168.1.1 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.1
```

**Example RESTCONF request**

```http
GET https://<device-ip>/restconf/data/interfaces/interface=GigabitEthernet0%2F1
Authorization: Basic <base64-credentials>
Accept: application/yang-data+json
```

Choose the method that matches your device’s capabilities and your preferred management protocol.
